reason: The text describes the opposite scenario: the congregation (כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֔ה) complains against the leaders (וַיִּלֹּ֥נוּ כָל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה עַל־ הַנְּשִׂיאִֽים - 'all the congregation murmured against the leaders'). The leaders then defend their sworn covenant with the Gibeonites rather than complain about the people; they explain their position to the congregation but do not lodge complaints about the people's conduct.
